title: parseJavaTrace attributes frames of tab-indented 'Suppressed:' exceptions to the main exception
property: frames of a suppressed exception are not included in the frames of the primary exception
property_test: suppressed frames are not attributed to the main exception
input:
java.lang.RuntimeException: boom
	at p.A.run(A.java:3)
	Suppressed: java.io.IOException: x
		at p.B.close(B.java:9)
expected: frames only for A.java (the code splits the trace at Caused by/Suppressed to keep only the primary exception)
actual: frames contains both A.java and B.java, because the split regex /\n(?:Caused by|Suppressed): / requires the keyword at column 0
evidence: Java's Throwable.printStackTrace emits suppressed exceptions as '\tSuppressed: ...' (tab-indented); the code's own split on 'Suppressed: ' shows it intends to cut them off.
